sections.title: Two questions, thirty teams
sections.lede: This report asks the same two questions of every team it looks at.
sections.lede_zh: 本報告對每一支團隊都問同樣的兩個問題。
sections.body:
The first question is computational. Where does a project stop being wet biology and start being a model, a pipeline, a dataset, a piece of software? What did that layer actually decide — did it change an experiment, or was it decoration added after the fact? The teams that win are increasingly the ones where the answer is "it changed the experiment".

The second question is social. Who outside the team touched this project, and what did they change about it? A list of meetings is not integrated human practices. A design that is visibly different because somebody outside the lab said something is.

Everything else here — the trend tabs, the roadmap — exists to answer a third question that only GEMS Research can answer: given what 2026 looked like, what should a growing research institution in Taiwan be building in 2027 and beyond?
sections.body_zh:
第一個問題關於運算。一個專案在哪裡不再只是濕實驗生物學，而開始成為模型、管線、資料集或軟體？這一層究竟決定了什麼——它改變了實驗，還是事後補上的裝飾？越來越多得獎團隊的答案是「它改變了實驗」。

第二個問題關於社會。團隊之外有誰接觸過這個專案，而他們改變了什麼？列一串會議紀錄不是整合式人類實踐；因為實驗室外的某個人說了什麼，而讓設計明顯不同，才是。

其餘的部分——趨勢頁、路線圖——都是為了回答第三個只有 GEMS Research 能回答的問題：看過 2026 年的樣貌之後，一個在台灣成長中的研究機構，在 2027 年以後應該建造什麼？

sections.title: Why the dry lab is the roadmap
sections.title_zh: 為什麼乾實驗室就是路線圖
sections.lede: GEMS Research is becoming an institution, not a team. Institutions are defined by what they can still do after the current students graduate.
sections.lede_zh: GEMS Research 正在從一支團隊成為一個機構。機構的定義，在於現在這批學生畢業之後，它還能做什麼。
sections.body:
A wet lab is bounded by its benches, its reagents budget and the hours its students are physically present. A dry lab is bounded by what its people know and what they have written down. That asymmetry is the whole argument: computational capability compounds across years in a way that pipetting skill does not, because a model, a pipeline or a calibrated measurement protocol survives the student who built it.

This is also where the field has moved. Protein design, metabolic modelling and measurement standardisation are no longer the specialist corner of a project — in 2026 they are frequently the project. The teams on the 2026 podium did not win because they ran more gels.

So the roadmap below is deliberately about capability, not about any single 2027 project idea. Pick a phase and start.
sections.body_zh:
濕實驗室受限於實驗檯、試劑預算，以及學生實際在場的時數。乾實驗室則受限於人員所知，以及他們寫下了什麼。這個不對稱就是整個論點：運算能力會跨年度累積，而移液技巧不會——因為一個模型、一條管線或一份校正過的量測流程，會比建造它的那位學生留得更久。

這也是整個領域移動的方向。蛋白質設計、代謝建模與量測標準化不再是專案裡的專家角落；在 2026 年，它們經常就是專案本身。站上 2026 頒獎台的團隊，不是因為多跑了幾道膠。

因此以下的路線圖刻意談能力，而不是任何單一的 2027 專案構想。挑一個階段，開始做。

roadmap.title: Phase 1 · Make the current work reproducible
roadmap.title_zh: 階段一 · 讓現有工作可重現
roadmap.lede: Before building anything new, make what already exists survivable by the next cohort.
roadmap.lede_zh: 在建造新東西之前，先讓既有成果能被下一屆接手。
items: **Put every analysis in version control.** One GEMS Research GitHub organisation, one repository per project, with the raw data, the notebook and the figure-generating script in the same place. If a figure cannot be regenerated from the repository, it does not count as a result.

**Write down the measurement protocols.** Calibration standards, units, replicate counts, how uncertainty was computed. The 2026 Best Measurement teams all did this; it is the cheapest credibility a dry lab can buy.
**Standardise the environment.** One `environment.yml` or `requirements.txt` per project, Python 3.12+, pinned versions. A student should be able to clone and run in under ten minutes.
**Archive the 2026 ReLEAF dry lab properly** — the OD600 signal processing, the optogenetic circuit model, the hardware firmware — as the first entry in the institutional record.
items_zh: **把所有分析放進版本控制。** 一個 GEMS Research GitHub organisation，一個專案一個 repository，原始資料、notebook 與產生圖表的腳本放在同一處。若一張圖無法從 repository 重新產生，它就不算結果。
**寫下量測流程。** 校正標準品、單位、重複次數、不確定度如何計算。2026 年所有最佳量測獎團隊都做到了這點；這是乾實驗室能買到最便宜的可信度。
**統一環境。** 每個專案一份 `environment.yml` 或 `requirements.txt`，Python 3.12 以上，版本鎖定。學生應該能在十分鐘內 clone 下來就跑起來。
**妥善歸檔 2026 ReLEAF 的乾實驗室成果** —— OD600 訊號處理、光遺傳電路模型、硬體韌體 —— 作為機構紀錄的第一筆。
roadmap.outcome: A new student can reproduce any 2026 figure from the repository alone, without asking anybody.
roadmap.outcome_zh: 新進學生只靠 repository 就能重現 2026 年的任何一張圖，不需要問任何人。

roadmap.title: Phase 2 · Build the core modelling skill
roadmap.title_zh: 階段二 · 建立核心建模能力
roadmap.lede: Two tracks, taught deliberately, with a real deliverable at the end of each.
roadmap.lede_zh: 兩條軌道，刻意教學，每條都有真實的產出。
items: **Track A — dynamical systems.** ODE models of genetic circuits, parameter fitting to the team's own data, sensitivity analysis, identifiability. Tools: Python with SciPy and lmfit, Tellurium/COPASI for the SBML side. Deliverable: a circuit model fitted to real GEMS time-course data, with confidence intervals on every parameter.

**Track B — structural and sequence modelling.** Structure prediction and protein design with the current open stack. Deliverable: a designed or selected variant with a documented computational rationale, taken to the bench.
**Teach uncertainty before teaching models.** Error propagation, replicate design, what a fit actually claims. Most student models fail here, not at the mathematics.
**Run a weekly dry-lab clinic.** One hour, somebody presents a figure, everyone else attacks it. This is how modelling taste transmits between cohorts.
items_zh: **軌道 A —— 動力系統。** 基因電路的 ODE 模型、以自身資料擬合參數、敏感度分析、可辨識性。工具：Python 搭配 SciPy 與 lmfit，SBML 端使用 Tellurium/COPASI。產出：一個以 GEMS 真實時間序列資料擬合的電路模型，每個參數都附信賴區間。
**軌道 B —— 結構與序列建模。** 以目前的開源工具鏈進行結構預測與蛋白質設計。產出：一個經過設計或篩選的變體，附上完整的運算理由，並實際進到實驗檯。
**先教不確定度，再教模型。** 誤差傳遞、重複設計、一次擬合究竟主張了什麼。多數學生模型敗在這裡，而不是數學。
**每週一次乾實驗室診療會。** 一小時，一個人報一張圖，其他人負責挑戰它。建模的品味就是這樣在屆與屆之間傳下去的。
roadmap.outcome: Two or three students who can independently build, fit and defend a model — and who can teach the next two or three.
roadmap.outcome_zh: 有兩三位學生能獨立建立、擬合並為自己的模型辯護——並且能教會下兩三位。

roadmap.title: Phase 3 · Ship one tool the outside world uses
roadmap.title_zh: 階段三 · 做出一個外界真的會用的工具
roadmap.lede: The difference between a competition team and a research centre is whether anybody outside uses what you built.
roadmap.lede_zh: 競賽團隊與研究中心的差別，在於外界有沒有人用你做的東西。
items: **Pick one narrow, real problem** that GEMS has genuine data on — the strongest candidate is the optogenetic induction and OD600 measurement work from ReLEAF, where GEMS already has instrumentation, data and a Best Measurement award behind it.
**Build it as a deployed web tool, not a notebook.** Documented, licensed, with example data, a DOI, and a URL anybody can open. Teams that only publish source code get used by nobody.
**Design for other people's data from day one.** Input format, validation, error messages. This is the single most common failure in iGEM software.
**Get three outside users and write down what broke.** Other Taiwanese schools, a university lab, a 2027 iGEM team. Their complaints are the roadmap for version two.
items_zh: **挑一個狹窄而真實的問題**，而且 GEMS 手上有真正的資料——最強的候選是 ReLEAF 的光遺傳誘導與 OD600 量測工作，GEMS 已經有儀器、有資料，背後還有一座最佳量測獎。
**把它做成已部署的網頁工具，而不是 notebook。** 有文件、有授權、有範例資料、有 DOI，以及任何人都能打開的網址。只釋出原始碼的團隊，沒有人會用。
**從第一天就為別人的資料設計。** 輸入格式、驗證、錯誤訊息。這是 iGEM 軟體最常見的單一失敗原因。
**找到三位外部使用者，並記錄哪裡壞了。** 其他台灣學校、一間大學實驗室、一支 2027 iGEM 團隊。他們的抱怨就是第二版的路線圖。
roadmap.outcome: A tool with a URL, a licence, documentation and users who are not GEMS students.
roadmap.outcome_zh: 一個有網址、有授權、有文件，而且使用者不是 GEMS 學生的工具。

roadmap.title: Phase 4 · Become a place other people come to
roadmap.title_zh: 階段四 · 成為別人會來的地方
roadmap.lede: Institutional standing comes from being useful to people who owe you nothing.
roadmap.lede_zh: 機構地位來自於：對那些不欠你任何東西的人仍然有用。
items: **Run a dry-lab school for Taiwanese iGEM and high-school teams.** Modelling, measurement, reproducibility. Teaching forces the material to become transmissible, and it builds the network that later supplies collaborators.
**Publish.** A methods paper, a preprint, or a well-documented dataset. One citable artefact per year changes how every later conversation starts.

**Keep a standing partnership with a university lab and a non-academic stakeholder** — a farm, a clinic, a municipal body. The stakeholder relationship is what makes human practices real rather than performed, and it is the thing competition teams cannot build in nine months.
**Maintain the trend watch.** This report should be regenerated at least twice a year; the academic and industry tabs are built to be re-run.
items_zh: **為台灣的 iGEM 與高中團隊辦一所乾實驗室學校。** 建模、量測、可重現性。教學會逼迫內容變得可傳遞，也建立起日後提供合作者的人脈網絡。
**發表。** 一篇方法論文、一份預印本，或一套文件完整的資料集。每年一個可被引用的產物，會改變此後每一次對話的起點。
**與一間大學實驗室和一個非學術利害關係人維持長期夥伴關係** —— 一座農場、一間診所、一個地方機關。利害關係人關係是讓人類實踐成為真實而非表演的關鍵，也是競賽團隊在九個月內建立不起來的東西。
**持續追蹤趨勢。** 這份報告每年至少重新生成兩次；學術與產業頁就是為了可重跑而設計的。
roadmap.outcome: GEMS Research is cited, invited and asked for help by people who were never GEMS students.
roadmap.outcome_zh: GEMS Research 被從未是 GEMS 學生的人引用、邀請並尋求協助。
